instruments.title: Instrument lifecycle gate
instruments.off: Instrument lifecycle gate: neither %(days_knob)s nor %(instruments_knob)s is configured ⇒ this gate is off (pluggable module; to enable: %(days_knob)s=days turns on constant-value detection; %(instruments_knob)s=instruments.json registers falsified methods)
instruments.days_unparseable: %(days_knob)s=%(value)r cannot be parsed as a number of days — fix the config (or drop the knob)
instruments.ledger_missing: ledger is missing: %(path)s — run facts.py first
instruments.registry_missing: REFLECT_INSTRUMENTS=%(name)s is set but the registry file is absent — register first (or drop the knob)
instruments.ledger_empty: ledger is empty — empty is not a pass (zero-value guard): first check whether measure() is broken
instruments.first_seen_unparseable: `%(key)s` has an unparseable first_seen (%(first_seen)r) — the constant-value rule cannot be evaluated (if it cannot be read, say so; do not guess)
instruments.constant_return: `%(key)s` has not changed since %(first_seen)s (%(days).0f days, constant threshold %(threshold).0f days) — confirm by hand: is this cmd measuring, or returning the same number forever? (instrument-silent-drift check, issue #6 ①)
instruments.entry_malformed: method registry entry has a malformed shape (text and why are both required): %(entry)r
instruments.falsified_method: `%(key)s`'s cmd contains a **falsified method** fragment %(text)r (%(why)s; correct method in %(fixed_in)s) — a bad method must not stay in the ledger
